The fitness score is very negative (-117.9) with high uncertainty (SEM 4.66, only 5 eval episodes). The reward schema includes a success_bonus of 100.0 but the conditions are strict (both legs contact, angle<0.1, x<0.1, y<0.1, vx<0.1, vy<0.1) and the crash_penalty is -100.0. The shaping reward is negative distance and vertical speed, which may encourage hovering. The leg_contact_bonus of 10.0 may reward landing off-pad. The next hypothesis is to strengthen the success signal and adjust penalties to avoid overwhelming the agent with negative feedback. Since this is the first iteration, no negative edges exist.
